brief.question: Does the full quartic reduced Gaunt polynomial support consistent one-loop two-point corrections with every retained physical mode and momentum interaction included?
brief.from_parent: Parent run 196cf70e-cad9-4208-9819-2aaaf78359de completed 24 exact directions and the 515-term quartic polynomial, then failed 32-versus-64 control convergence. All highest-order (64-point) reference checks passed. This child changes quadrature to 64/128 and keeps the same tolerances, Hamiltonian, cases, and run recipe.
brief.healthy: 22 exact fit directions yield a polynomial reproducing all seven frozen parent cases; two new held-out mixed-functional contractions raise independent cross-invariant validation coverage from rank three to five. Direct frequency integration agrees with the analytic tadpole and bubble formula below 1e-9, normalized magnetic components agree, and mixed QP corrections vanish. The four-point bookkeeping controls pass.
brief.noise: N=3 and ten profiles remain fixed, with one radial profile per parity. This is a two-point coefficient under a bare midpoint/Weyl prescription, not four-graviton scattering or a physical large-N limit. Errors are displayed in units of 1e-12; report raw scientific values when interpreting. Negative perturbative corrections alone do not prove instability. The independent corner and sixth-order audits are derivations, not measured loop results.
brief.worth_a_flag: Any exact historical/held-out check fails; 64-versus-128 convergence fails at the same 1e-9 relative plus 1e-12 control absolute tolerance; gravitational two-point agreement, QP cancellation or normalized rotations fail; or progress stalls without a reported ingredient. A failed control must stop before any claimed successful final result.
brief.decided: Local CPU and standard-library Python. Parent runtime 108 seconds; exact classical work is repeated from the unchanged functions. Refined controls and gravitational two-point stages have no completed parent timing. The failed parent source stays immutable. Reports additionally give an analytic fixed-mode quantum completion; this run does not test a spectrum or that proof.
